story:
Aamir Abbas trained as a physician, graduating MBBS in 2007, and moved into epidemiology and data science to work on health problems at population scale.

He completed an MS in Epidemiology and Biostatistics at Aga Khan University and, as a Fulbright Scholar, a Master's in Health Data Analytics and Information Technology at Carnegie Mellon University.

Today he directs the Data and Digital department at Vital Pakistan Trust, serves as Gates Foundation Principal Investigator on a study of vulnerability among women in Pakistan, and writes and teaches about health AI for clinicians and researchers.

education.degree: Master's in Health Data Analytics and Information Technology
